verdicts.evidence: lines 538-559, 688-699, 707, 757-775, 816, 860-874: every button (Try again, Clear search, Mark complete, Move to another day, Move job, Cancel, Undo move, Save note, dialog buttons) has a listener that calls the api or changes the view
lines 466, 663, 723, 792, 881: all jobs, notes and counts come from api calls; counts computed from the loaded list (518-521); no hardcoded sample values or placeholder text
lines 864-865: the confirm dialog names the job number and customer and the invoice consequence; the move form (210-220) sits under the job's When row (198) on the same screen

lines 562-564, 583, 703: note draft is written to sessionStorage per job on every input and read back in showJob, so it survives reload and Back; on a failed save the textarea is left untouched (737-744)
line 869: dialog opens with focus on 'Keep as booked', so Enter does not complete; move date is preselected to the next valid day (759-765) and still needs an explicit 'Move job' submit
lines 173-186: the list and its search are on the opening screen; lines 233-241: a note is added inline on the job screen; move is an inline panel (210); only the irreversible complete opens a dialog

lines 166-243: list, search, day links, job details, notes, add note, move and complete all map to brief tasks; day links are needed to see jobs moved to another day; no stat cards, feeds or extra panels
lines 207-208, 217-218, 238, 251-252: job view has one .primary (Mark complete), move and note forms use the secondary style, the dialog has one .primary

line 252: the irreversible 'Complete and send invoice' button carries class primary (filled brand colour, line 62) while the safe 'Keep as booked' is secondary; line 207 also styles 'Mark complete' as primary. Focus is on Keep (869) but the styling test fails
lines 358-361: buttons are only aria-disabled while their own request runs (exception); line 635: complete and move actions are removed when the job is complete; no other disabled controls
no title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script
lines 161-254 and all message strings (471-474, 507, 671-676, 715, 738-743, 784-812, 865, 892-899): text is only about jobs, notes, moves and invoices; nothing about implementation or mock data

line 214, 637: the only hint, 'Once moved, this job cannot be moved back to today', appears inside the move form and only when the job is today; line 865: the invoice warning is in the confirm dialog at the decision
lines 166-254: headings, labels and buttons only; no sentence narrates the screen or how to use its controls; the single hint is one line at the date field
lines 174, 211, 234: labels have no restating helper text; the dialog title (864) names the job and its text (865) adds the consequence; the move hint adds new information
lines 167, 420, 615 and message strings: headings are 'Jobs today, ...' and the customer name; no greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks

lines 179, 184, 207-208, 217-218, 223, 238, 251-252: 'Try again', 'Clear search', 'Mark complete', 'Move to another day', 'Move job', 'Cancel', 'Undo move', 'Save note', 'Keep as booked', 'Complete and send invoice'; no OK/Submit/Yes

lines 198-203, 620: labels are When, Status, What needs doing, Address, Phone, Job number; status maps to 'Complete'/'Booked'; the internal id job_7xx is never rendered as text, only the HH- job number

same strings as COPY-011 plus 715, 784-786: wording is 'Could not load', 'was not saved', 'Choose a date after today'; no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals
lines 504-512: zero jobs shows 'No jobs are booked for today.' with a link to tomorrow's (or today's) jobs; line 231: 'No notes yet.' sits directly above the add-note form

lines 504-512 (nothing booked, link to another day), 514-516 with 502 (no match text naming the query plus 'Clear search'), 469-476 (load error styled as error with 'Try again'): three distinct messages and actions

lines 467-477, 664-679: failed loads show an in-place error and 'Try again', keeping cached data; 737-744, 804-813, 896-905: failed note, move and complete show the error at the control, keep input and leave the button to retry

lines 436, 447-456, 463: skeleton rows and 'Loading jobs' appear at once; 591, 597: 'Loading notes'/'Loading job'; 721, 790, 820, 879: busy labels on buttons; calls take at most 1.5s so no progress or cancel is needed
